body.x: Netatmo showed ‘smart smoke alarm’ to prevent fire at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

Smart smoke alarm sends real-time notifications to smartphones anytime they can be alerted by smoke alarms to act from miles away and ensures that all Smart Lighting is activated when smoke is detected.

A battery that lasts approximately 10 years is equipped so that users can use securely for 10 years. It produces a self-checking report that is transmitted directly to the smartphone at the user's convenience by conducting an autonomous battery and an overall performance test continuously.

There is also a smart surveillance camera called ‘Presence’ that detects all movements within 20 meters and alerts you to your smartphone and ‘Interior siren’ that immediately beeps and detects indoor risks.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
